title: Kyle and Friends
text: So it's been almost a year of this. We've missed out on so much. It's just made me think a lot about the relationships I have, especially here at SNL. So maybe it's time I put myself out there a little more. Oh, what's up, Kyle? Hey, Jay. Thanks for getting the door. Yeah. First off, I just want to say, sorry if I've been, like, awkward for the past seven and a half years. Oh, no, I mean, you're fine. Ah, cool. Yeah, sometimes I feel like I make you and everyone here uncomfortable. Uh, nah, man, you're cool. Well, anyway, you're so dope. Update's amazing, and you and Jost are the perfect team. Thanks, man. I appreciate that. Do you like me? What? Um, yeah, sure. You do? All right! Thanks, Jay! Looks like I've got my first friend at SNL. Bowen. Dude. You are killing it on the show. All the wigs and crazy-ass voices. Thanks, Kyle. Quick question. Do you think I'm a loser? Uh, no. What? Dang! It's going down! Kyle, sorry about that. Whoa. All right, this is amazing. Like, dude, I have two friends now. But why stop there? What do you say we cue that rock music? Hey, hey, the crew. What up? Hey, players. Got some, like, dumb little random gifts for you guys, because that's kind of who I be. Hm. Mikey. I remember you mentioning you had a son. I thought he'd dig this. Oh, okay. I mean, he's eight, but... Do you remember our characters from the game night sketch with Daniel Craig, Eric, and Lisa? I don't think we had names. Well, I made about a hundred T-shirts. One's for you, and the rest are for your family. So, anyway, I got that rum that Lil Wayne gave us three years ago. Kind of having a little Valentine's Day kickback. Not romantic or nothing. Just the homies. Don't spank me. There you go. All right, see you guys at eight. Oh, Lorne. Kyle, go away. You know the deal. Lil Wayne rum, Valentine's hang. I don't like you. Sure, Lorne. Ooh, I got work to do. Guess rehearsal's running long. No worries. Hey, Kyle. Oh, hey. When the homies come, the list comes to party. You know it's on. Um, actually, I came because some of the cast members, they told me you're making them feel pretty uncomfortable. You know, putting them on the spot, asking them if they like you, spanking them. Look, I like you, Kyle, but if you don't want to be a loser, you're gonna have to stop acting like one. Make sense? Sure. Hey, Regina. Have a good show. And break a leg. Yeah, it was sad. Did you get one of this Valentine's goodie bags? Yeah, SNL playing cards. Oh! Oh! Regina, are you okay? Why? Why? Oh, no. I guess I'll have to host. And as you know, everybody wants to be friends with the host. Oh, wait. Oh, wait a minute. Yeah. I think I'll be okay. Well, I'm . Guess it's my turn to get spanked. Oh, Kyle! Sorry.
